name: Delta SkyMiles® Platinum American Express Card
penalty_apr_trigger: Missing at least the Minimum Payment Due, or a returned payment; applies for at least 6 months and is reviewed every 6 months after that
pay_over_time_fee: Up to 1.33% per month of each purchase placed in a Plan It plan

welcome_bonus.bonus: As high as 90,000 miles plus a $300 statement credit
welcome_bonus.requirement: after you spend $4,000 in purchases in the first 6 months of Card Membership; welcome offers vary and you may not be eligible for an offer
welcome_bonus.estimated_value: $1,035 for the miles, plus the $300 credit as cash

verdict.text: Keep only if you fly Delta with a companion

earn_rates.category: Restaurants worldwide, plus U.S. takeout & delivery

earn_note: Fine for Delta spend, but you earn SkyMiles, which have no published award chart and no transfer partners. For everyday spend outside Delta, a flat-rate card in a transferable currency earns more and leaves you freer in how you redeem.

points.note: Airline-locked and dynamically priced. Two escapes: top up from Amex MR (1:1), or book Delta metal via Virgin Atlantic for far fewer miles than SkyMiles charges.

transfer_partners.highlight: SkyMiles can't be transferred out; they're stuck in Delta's program.
transfer_partners.recent_changes: You can transfer INTO SkyMiles from Amex MR (1:1), Chase UR and Capital One, useful for topping up an award.

credits.name: Free Checked Bags
credits.subtitle: 1st + 2nd (domestic)
credits.description: First checked bag free on Delta flights (you + up to 8 on the reservation); second bag free domestic.
tips: ~$35 each way per bag per person, so a family checking bags on one round trip clears most of the fee.
You don't even need to pay for the flight with this card.

credits.name: Rideshare Credit
credits.subtitle: $10/mo · enroll
credits.description: Monthly U.S. rideshare credit with Uber, Lyft, Curb or Alto.
tips: Enroll, then one qualifying ride a month recovers the full $120.

credits.name: Resy Dining Credit
credits.subtitle: $10/mo · new in 2026
credits.description: Up to $10/month at U.S. Resy restaurants marked eligible on Resy.com when you pay, and at purchases made directly on Tock since Sep 15, 2026.
tips: Stacks with your Amex Platinum's $400 Resy credit: two cards paying you at the same restaurants.
Monthly, no rollover; one Resy meal a month captures it.

credits.name: Companion Certificate
credits.subtitle: Main Cabin · annual
credits.description: Each year after renewal, one round-trip Main Cabin companion ticket within the U.S., Mexico, the Caribbean, or Central America; companion pays only taxes and fees, capped at $80 on round-trip domestic itineraries and $250 on round-trip international ones.
tips: One qualifying round trip erases the $350 fee. Best on expensive routes; value the slider by the fare you'd save.
Book fare classes L, U, T, X or V; the cheapest basic buckets sometimes don't qualify.

credits.name: Delta Stays Credit
credits.subtitle: prepaid hotels · calendar year
credits.description: Up to $150/yr (calendar year) on prepaid hotels or vacation rentals booked through Delta Stays on delta.com.
tips: Resets on the calendar year, not renewal, so a new cardholder can use it twice on one annual fee.
Use it on a Delta Stays booking you'd make anyway.

credits.name: Global Entry / TSA PreCheck Credit
credits.subtitle: $120 GE / $85 TSA · every 4 yrs
credits.description: Statement credit for a Global Entry ($120) or TSA PreCheck ($85) application fee, one credit across the account every 4 years. Shown here amortized to an annual figure.
tips: Apply for Global Entry, not just TSA PreCheck; it includes TSA PreCheck and covers the same credit.

insurance.detail: Not offered; this card carries the standard Global Assist Hotline, which refers rather than pays

protection_note: Thinner than the others: the $300/12-hour trip delay is weaker than the $500/6 hrs elsewhere, the rental cover is secondary, and there is no trip cancellation or interruption insurance at all. Global Assist here is the standard hotline, which makes referrals rather than paying for an evacuation. It does keep Amex cell-phone protection. For trips you want fully insured, reach for a card with real trip-cancellation limits.
rental_note: Secondary only: it pays after your own auto policy. If you carry a card with free primary coverage, that's the better one to put rentals on.

status_perks.name: Medallion head start
status_perks.note: $2,500 MQD annually plus a spend boost: a meaningful shortcut to Silver/Gold if you're pursuing Delta status.

status_perks.name: Hertz Five Star
status_perks.note: Mid-tier Hertz status: counter skip, free additional driver, upgrades.

status_perks.name: Lounge access
status_perks.note: None on its own (Sky Club needs the $650 Reserve). Your Amex Platinum already covers 10 Sky Club visits on Delta flights.

services.name: Free checked bags & priority boarding
services.detail: 1st bag free (worldwide) for you + up to 8 companions on the reservation; 2nd bag free domestic; Zone 5 priority boarding.

services.name: Complimentary upgrade queue
services.detail: Even without Medallion status, you're added to the upgrade list (below Medallion/Reserve members).

services.name: MQD Headstart, Boost & TakeOff 15
services.detail: $2,500 MQD head start, $1 MQD per $20 spent, and 15% off award flights booked with miles.

services.name: Resy credit & no FX fees
services.detail: The Resy credit pays at eligible U.S. Resy restaurants; plus zero foreign transaction fees and the Global Assist Hotline.

additional_cards.title: Additional cards

benefits.text: Free to add: no annual fee for additional Platinum cards
No free checked bag or priority boarding of their own: both belong to the primary cardholder
No Global Entry / TSA PreCheck credit of their own: one credit across the account every 4 years
Shares the account's credits, no separate set

additional_cards.note: Additional Delta Platinum cards are free. The free checked bag and priority boarding stay with the primary cardholder: the bag waiver covers up to nine people on the primary's reservation, whether or not they hold a card, so an extra card adds nothing on a separate booking.

timeline.text: The Resy credit started counting purchases made directly on Tock at U.S. restaurants.

No fee increase. Delta's announcement for this tier covers a free second checked bag on domestic flights and the companion certificate working on the flight portion of a Delta Vacations package. The rideshare, Resy and Delta Stays credits are all live on the card, but Delta did not date them to this refresh.
Delta Sky Club access restricted across Amex cards (visit caps introduced).
Fee raised $250 → $350; SkyMiles and Medallion shifted to a spend-based (MQD) model.
Standard co-brand with companion certificate and free first bag.
